restated: An adversary with existing access to Windows hosts on this network harvested credentials from those hosts.
what_would_confirm: LSASS memory access or dumping (e.g., procdump, comsvcs.dll MiniDump, Mimikatz), SAM/SECURITY/LSA registry hive exports, NTDS.dit or cached credential extraction, suspicious access to lsass.exe by non-standard processes, or credential material appearing in attacker tooling/telemetry.
what_would_refute: No evidence of credential-dumping tooling, no anomalous lsass.exe access, no registry hive or NTDS.dit extraction, and no credential material observed leaving or being used from the affected hosts.
